custody_statement: Integrity begins at the collector. Each record hash is recomputable from the exported fields and commitments; chain links and daily roots are recomputable from the exported records. This export proves the records were not altered after ingest. It does not prove the source systems reported every event, and it is not a legal admissibility opinion. Hashes and roots alone only show a bundle is consistent with itself; when manifest.sig.json is present and verifies against the published Provantix export keys, the export is exactly what Provantix issued.
caveats: A valid signature shows who signed this. It does not show that what is signed is true.
Integrity is not completeness. Nothing in here was altered since it was recorded, but that does not show that every action was captured.
scope_statement: It holds 0 records chosen by name (cost statement 2026-10, version 1), not every record this organization had stored: 0 records, with no records. It says nothing about activity that was not delivered to Provantix, and nothing about records outside this export.
